readings.moment: When the temple bell struck nine, the watches were taken out at the family's dinner.
Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine, when the watches were taken out.
When the temple struck ten, Mme Monnier looked at the salon clock.
When the temple struck ten, the salon clock showed five minutes to ten.
Casimir went out at twenty-eight minutes past ten by the salon clock.
A moment after Casimir came back, the hall clock struck eleven.

durations: Thirty years of playing piquet (the doctor and Mme Monnier) — a span before the evening, not between two moments of it; excluded.
A moment after Casimir came back, the hall clock struck eleven (Casimir's return to 11:00, a short interval, not precisely stated).
whereabouts: Félix was among the company at the family dinner when the watches were taken out at nine and was scolded by Aurèle in front of everyone.
The family and guests went through from dinner to the salon after the watches were taken out.
Mme Monnier and the doctor (Casimir) sat down to piquet in the salon.
Mme Monnier and the doctor played piquet without a break until Casimir got up to fetch his cigars.
Casimir went out at 10:28 by the salon clock to fetch his cigars.
Mme Monnier sat down at the piano at once when Casimir asked her to play.
Mme Monnier played Chopin at the piano until Casimir came back, and stopped when he came in.
Casimir came back shortly before the hall clock struck eleven.
At table, Monsieur Girard and Aurèle said things to each other over the soup.
At table, Aurèle told the others what was wrong with their watches.
